summary: Short quiet-street kerb at a corner, homes 13-14 m away both sides.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 13-14 m away on both sides; corner verge with trees gives some screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a sealed residential street; a car is parked just east, so room exists.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street at a junction, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along this kerb, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Short stretch, about one van length
sun_shade: Street trees and corner scrub shade the west end; open to afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: Broomfield Street, just east of the corner, beside the grassy corner verge
